headline: Speak. It types where you work.
body: Press Ctrl+Win, speak, press again. Clean text lands at your cursor.
caption: Your voice can be the first draft. Press Ctrl+Win, speak, press again—and Mumble pastes clean text at your cursor. #Mumble #VoiceToText #Windows
alt: Mumble's gold waveform and floating Island flowing into a blinking text cursor on a black background.

headline: Voice-to-text that follows your cursor.
body: Dictate where you already write—email, chat, documents, or code.
caption: Mumble is a layer over the tools you already use. Dictate into email, chat, documents, or code without moving your work somewhere else. #Productivity #Dictation
alt: A gold Mumble Island connected to four generic email, chat, document, and code windows.

headline: One shortcut. One thought. Done.
body: Ctrl+Win starts and stops everyday dictation.
caption: Press Ctrl+Win. Speak naturally. Press it again. That is Mumble's everyday dictation loop. Save the shortcut for later. #WindowsTips #VoiceTyping
alt: An oversized Ctrl plus Win keycap above a gold waveform and a pasted-text confirmation.

headline: Private starts with local.
body: Local transcription is the default. Audio is processed on your PC unless you explicitly choose Cloud transcription.
caption: Mumble starts with Local transcription. Your audio is processed on your PC unless you explicitly switch to Cloud transcription. Privacy begins with a clear default. #Privacy #LocalFirst
alt: A gold waveform entering a computer chip protected by a green lock, with Local marked as the default.

headline: Core dictation, even offline.
body: With Local transcription selected and Pro Mode off, Mumble's core dictation workflow can stay offline.
caption: Choose Local transcription and turn Pro Mode off when you want Mumble's core dictation workflow to stay offline. Clear controls, no vague promises. #OfflineTools #LocalAI
alt: A Local mode switch, disconnected network icon, gold waveform, and text cursor showing an offline dictation path.

headline: AI polish gets the text—not the audio.
body: When cloud Pro Mode is enabled, Mumble sends transcript text to your chosen provider. Audio stays out of that polish step.
qualifier: Requires a configured AI provider; provider charges may apply.
caption: Cloud Pro Mode sends transcript text—not audio—to the AI provider you choose. Mumble keeps transcription and AI polish as separate, understandable steps. #PrivacyByDesign #AIWriting
alt: A waveform remains behind a lock while only a text document travels to a provider-neutral AI chip.

headline: Meet the Deck.
body: Search transcripts, clipboard history, saved prompts, and favourites in one pinned workspace.
caption: The Deck brings transcripts, clipboard history, saved prompts, and favourites into one searchable workspace. Open it with Ctrl+Alt+D. #ProductivityTools #Mumble
alt: A black-and-gold Mumble Deck with search, transcript, clipboard, prompt, and favourite sections.

headline: Your clipboard has a memory.
body: Mumble can retain copied text and images in searchable clipboard history.
caption: Copied text and images do not have to disappear into clipboard limbo. Mumble can retain them in searchable clipboard history inside the Deck. #ClipboardManager #WindowsApps
alt: Stacked clipboard cards containing text and abstract image thumbnails inside Mumble's Deck.

headline: 25 ways to work with text.
body: Summarise, Focus, Reply, Action items and more—plus five custom preset slots.
qualifier: AI transformations require a configured provider or compatible local model; provider charges may apply.
caption: Mumble includes 20 built-in presets—from Summarise and Focus to Reply and Action items—plus five custom slots for your own workflows. #WritingTools #AIPrompts
alt: A five-by-five grid of glass preset chips, including Summarise, Focus, Reply, Action items, and Custom.

headline: Highlight it. Capture it. Transform it.
body: Pull selected text from another app into the Deck, then run a preset or action.
qualifier: AI transformations require a configured provider or compatible local model; provider charges may apply.
caption: Highlight text in another app, capture it into the Deck, then run the preset or action you need. Existing text becomes useful input. #Workflow #TextTools
alt: Highlighted text moving through a Capture button into a Mumble preset and polished result.

headline: Rough idea → structured prompt.
body: Turn on Prompt from the Island, dictate the idea, and Mumble shapes it into a structured AI prompt.
cta: Say it before you overthink it
qualifier: Prompt shaping requires a configured provider or compatible local model; provider charges may apply.
caption: Turn on Prompt from the Island, dictate the rough idea, and Mumble shapes it into a structured AI prompt with a clearer role, task, and constraints. #PromptEngineering #Mumble
alt: A purple Prompt chip beside a rough dictated idea and structured role, task, and constraints fields.

headline: A meeting is more than audio.
body: Record up to four hours from your selected microphone—or import an audio file—then transcribe, replay, and review speaker-labelled segments.
caption: Record room audio from the selected microphone or import an audio file, then transcribe, replay, and review speaker-labelled segments in Mumble. #MeetingNotes #Transcription
alt: A meeting flow showing selected-microphone recording or audio import, transcript segments with speaker labels, replay, and processing icons.

headline: From meeting to next steps.
body: With an AI provider configured, summarise and extract action items, key decisions, and open questions.
qualifier: Requires a configured AI provider; provider charges may apply.
caption: With an AI provider configured, Mumble can turn a meeting transcript into a summary, action items, key decisions, and open questions. #MeetingProductivity #ActionItems
alt: A speaker-labelled meeting transcript feeding summary, action items, key decisions, and open questions cards.

headline: Read 11 file formats aloud.
body: PDF, DOCX, EPUB, HTML, RTF, Markdown, TXT, CSV, ODT, PPTX, and XLSX.
qualifier: Voice playback requires a configured TTS provider; provider charges may apply.
caption: Open PDF, DOCX, EPUB, HTML, RTF, Markdown, TXT, CSV, ODT, PPTX, or XLSX in Mumble Reader and follow the live word highlight. #TextToSpeech #Reader
alt: Eleven file-format badges surrounding a document with one word highlighted in gold.

headline: Search what you see—or say.
body: Highlight text and press Ctrl+Alt+S, or speak a query. Choose Perplexity, Google, or Brave.
caption: Highlight text and press Ctrl+Alt+S—or speak a query when nothing is selected. Mumble can search with Perplexity, Google, or Brave. #SearchTips #VoiceSearch
alt: Highlighted text and a gold waveform converging into a search bar with Perplexity, Google, and Brave labels.

headline: Your voice workflow, in numbers.
body: Track words, pace, streaks, activity, and mode mix. Time saved stays clearly labelled as an estimate.
caption: Mumble Stats tracks words, pace, streaks, activity, and mode mix from your usage. Time saved remains clearly labelled as an estimate—because trust beats hype. #PersonalAnalytics
alt: A black-and-gold Stats dashboard with words, pace, streak, activity, mode mix, and an Estimated badge.

headline: Free Windows download. No account to start.
body: Mumble is free to download for Windows. Its code is MIT-licensed, and Local mode needs no account or API key.

alt: The Mumble icon beside Free Windows download, MIT-licensed code, and No account for Local mode badges.

headline: Ready when your cursor is.

caption: Install Mumble, place your cursor where you want the words, and press Ctrl+Win. Voice-to-text starts where your work already is. Download for Windows—free. #Mumble
alt: A Mumble download card with a Ctrl plus Win keycap, floating Island, and blinking cursor.

headline: The Mumble data path, in one diagram.

headline: Local by default. Cloud by choice.
body: Use on-device faster-whisper, or explicitly select Cloud transcription with a supported provider.
qualifier: Cloud transcription requires a configured provider; provider charges may apply.
caption: Use on-device faster-whisper by default, or explicitly select Cloud transcription with a supported provider. Mumble makes the choice visible instead of burying it.

headline: Your AI key. Your provider.

headline: Four defaults worth remembering.
body: Ctrl+Win record · Ctrl+Alt+V paste latest · Ctrl+Alt+D Deck · Ctrl+Alt+S search.
caption: Mumble defaults: Ctrl+Win record · Ctrl+Alt+V paste latest · Ctrl+Alt+D open Deck · Ctrl+Alt+S search. Save the card; customise them in Settings.
alt: Four glass keycap tiles labelled Record, Paste latest, Deck, and Search with their default shortcuts.

headline: Mumble is a layer, not a destination.
